BackgroundColorClass.helper: Optional. Choose a built-in Bootstrap or shared site background color for the full-width section.

CardBackgroundColor.helper: Choose a Bootstrap color. Cards use a transparent tint of the selected color. Light is used when no value is saved.

IconColor.helper: Optional. Choose a Bootstrap text color. The icon uses this color with a transparent matching background. Dark text on a light background is used when no value is saved.

AnimationLevel.helper: Controls Porto entrance animation and the strength of hover and click feedback. Reduced-motion preferences are always respected.

MarginTop.title: Margin (top)
MarginTop.helper: Optional. Controls spacing above this section.

MarginBottom.title: Margin (bottom)
MarginBottom.helper: Optional. Controls spacing below this section.

PaddingTop.title: Padding (top)
PaddingTop.helper: Optional. Controls inner spacing above the content.

PaddingBottom.title: Padding (bottom)
PaddingBottom.helper: Optional. Controls inner spacing below the content.
